description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeProfilePictureController class, which extends BaseViewEmployeeController. It handles the pre-rendering process for employee profile pictures, prepares Vue.js components with employee data and permissions, and includes functionality for capability checks related to employee photographs.

classes.name: EmployeeProfilePictureController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the employee profile picture view, initializing Vue.js components with employee data, and setting permissions for the employee's photograph functionality.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue.js component with employee number and allowed image types, sets component for rendering, and configures permissions based on the request data.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the list of capability checks (here, simply ['photograph']) needed before allowing certain actions.
